utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on for Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping it simple and flexible, so we can slot people in where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—let’s keep the repair drive moving and I’ll pass the details along so everyone knows when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—what’s the next thing you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, it’s still happening. What time did we land on again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We were aiming for Saturday morning, and folks are still gathering donations and sorting the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, so let’s make sure that’s the first update we spread. If you can help, I’ll line up the next steps from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center and keep the update simple.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to take the easiest bit off your plate—what’s the simplest task I can handle for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the updated time and location: Sunday at the community center. That’s the easiest and most important bit right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, send me the locations when you’re ready, and I’ll keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes—I'll send the locations, and let’s keep the repair drive on one fixed time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — if you’ve got the donation updates and the top repair priorities, I’ll turn them into a simple list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard people are still gathering donations, and the main thing is to list the most urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive—what time were you thinking this weekend so I can work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m thinking Saturday morning works best, maybe around 10. I’ll check the supplies list first and send you a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve got left and make a quick needs list. Just tell me what’s most needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — a short list of the most-needed items would be perfect, especially anything practical we can gather easily.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s pick a clear time for the repair drive and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — could you check which locations still need supplies and note any repair priorities?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check which locations still need supplies and note the top repair priorities, then report back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great—just send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira — I’ll send over the locations when I have them. I appreciate you keeping it organized and low-key.
